policies.title: Kyrgyz ordinary passports: Ukraine visa-free short visits
policies.summary: The in-force Ukraine–Kyrgyzstan agreement permits Kyrgyz citizens using a Kyrgyz passport to enter, transit and stay in Ukraine without a visa for up to 90 days.
conditions: The agreement identifies a passport of a citizen of the Kyrgyz Republic as a valid document for international travel.
Visa-free entry, transit and stay are limited to 90 days from border crossing; longer stays, employment and permanent residence require a visa.
Work, residence, special travel documents, wartime operational access and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Kyrgyz ordinary passports: Jordan visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Jordan's live Tourism Board table expressly lists Kyrgyzstan as eligible for a 40-JOD visitor visa obtained on arrival.
conditions: The table says the visitor visa can be obtained on arrival for 40 JOD.
Jordan's table says non-Jordanians must complete Gateway2Jordan registration and obtain its QR code before departure.
Work, residence, special documents, entry-point limits, carrier checks and final admission remain outside scope.

policies.title: Kyrgyz ordinary passports: Grenada visitor visa on arrival
policies.summary: Grenada's currently linked April 2024 Embassy schedule lists Kyrgyzstan as Port of Entry, which it defines as a visa granted on arrival.
conditions: The schedule defines Port of Entry as a visa granted on arrival in Grenada.
The schedule's 2024 update remains actively linked by Grenada's Embassy; recheck if Grenada publishes a replacement.
Work, study, residence, diplomatic, official, service and special-document treatment remain outside scope.

policies.title: Kyrgyz ordinary passports: Panama authorized visitor visa
policies.summary: Panama's live Embassy schedule expressly includes Kyrgyzstan in its authorized-visa cohort, requiring advance consular approval unless the separate third-country-document waiver applies.
conditions: Applies to an ordinary Kyrgyz passport holder travelling as a short visitor who does not qualify for Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver.
Authorized-visa applicants must appear in person at the consulate; approval may take up to 60 business days.
Work, residence, transit, special documents, consular-jurisdiction requirements and final admission remain outside scope.

application.label: Panama Embassy authorized-visa instructions
application.processingTime: Up to 60 business days, depending on verification and document completion.
steps: Determine that Panama's separate third-country visa or residence waiver does not apply.
Appear in person at the competent Panamanian consulate with the required authorized-visa application documents.
Do not finalize travel arrangements until the authorized visa has been granted.
